items.title: How exposure grows the longer a stored XSS goes undetected
items.description: The Scenario's comment page: every visitor who loads it while the malicious comment is still there runs it in their own session. Drag the sliders to see how daily traffic and how fast the comment gets caught change the number of sessions exposed before it's removed.

params.name: dailyVisitors
params.label: Visitors to the page per day

params.name: daysToFix
params.label: Days until the comment is found and removed
